zip: 同步四爪抓水碗-算法与复测.zip
scope: Independent review, prescribed-position FK comparison, one recreated failed seed 88000 with original v4 code. No training or hardware I/O.

fk_equivalence.interpretation: No large sign/frame mismatch found between V4 static screen and polynomial linked model when the same arm pose and rack coordinate are supplied.

planning_mismatch_seed88000.interpretation: The rack band is planned at a fixed nominal IK pose but applied to randomized parking/IK pose. Changing the free tool roll against a 16-sided bowl changes the narrow contact band.

controller_issues: Zero preload and early single-pad stop prevents closing through a compliant contact to an opposed grasp. Existing preload starts only after confirmed opposed contact, creating a startup deadlock.
Retry uses the dummy rack slide world axis for lateral correction rather than the actual tip-motion/contact Jacobian.
Shared polynomial laws remove two passive shape degrees of freedom per branch; this is an uncertain reduced mechanism, not identified loaded closed-chain dynamics.
recommended_order: Refine bowl circle sectors and verify contact-band convergence without changing physical diameter, mass, friction or collisions.
Plan at the actual parked arm pose and estimated bowl pose, including free-roll orientation.
Use bounded common-rack preload and complete approach/contact/centering state transitions; retain a single actuator.
Validate small contact trials and final hold/place before training.
For higher physical fidelity, model actual rods and passive closed-chain constraints, preserving a common drive rather than adding independent finger controls.
